name: Soga Asuma
source:
The boy in charge of developing GAIA under the Gai Institution; 14 years old.

As he rarely goes out in public, society at large knows nothing of Asuma’s existence.

He’s a prideful boy, even arrogant; friend or foe, he shows mercy to no one who dares display their incompetence.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
